\x1b[38;5;231m\x1b[49m⏺\x1b[39m Before I go further on the migration I need you to pick how we handle the legacy session records that still carry the
  old two-letter region codes, since rewriting them in place touches about forty thousand rows across three shards and
  cannot be rolled back without a restore from last night's snapshot, which would drop today's writes. Which way?

  - Rewrite in place tonight during the maintenance window
  - Keep both formats and translate on read
  - Leave them and only fix new records
